summary: This hubconf.py file is a PyTorch Hub configuration that re-exports model constructors from the geffnet library. It contains no original functions, classes, or callable APIs — only import statements and a dependencies variable. It serves as a pass-through for torch.hub to discover EfficientNet, MixNet, MobileNet, MNASNet, FBNet, and SPNASNet model variants.
note: No callable APIs to build examples for. This file is a list of re-exported imports with no original code logic.
